messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2026-03-17, the image resizer keeps original uploads for only 90 days. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The image resizer's storage for original uploads doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-17]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: team Dune owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2026-05-27, the bus retains messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-27]
- The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-11]
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-29]
    earlier: Per the change policy, the authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-18 to 2025-12-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-18]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026. [decision; valid 2025-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-22]
- The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during INC-2025-004. [valid 2025-02-05 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-004]
- Farah takes the first on-call rotation for team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-30]
